=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1908-1914 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Send Telegram notification" step sets `ALERT_LEVEL="WARNING"` for both `pr_auto_merge` and `pr_open`, but `pr_auto_merge` is set only after `gh pr merge --auto --squash --match-head-commit` succeeds (lines 1780-1781), so GitHub merges that PR without anyone acting.
  WHY: All reviewers rated this MAJOR. It breaks the alert contract in tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py, where WARNING and above mean a person must act and the default `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL` threshold is WARNING. As a result, every run whose PR CI outlasts the merge wait (default 10 minutes) pages operators for a PR that merges itself. The suggested fix is to raise only `pr_open` to WARNING; the static assertion `'ALERT_LEVEL="WARNING"\n            fi\n          else'` in tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py still matches after that change.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:879-881,1796-1801 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `WLA_JOB_START_EPOCH` is written in the `Resolve AI engine` step, after `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0` (865-869), but the 55-minute merge-wait clamp treats it as the job start.
  WHY: All three flagging reviewers rated this NIT. If checkout and setup take more than 5 minutes, the 55-minute cap runs past the job's `timeout-minutes: 60` (835). A late auto-merge wait can then be cancelled before the step writes its `delivery`/`report_pr_number` outputs. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at this and did not report it, because nothing shows setup taking more than 5 minutes.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_failure_contract.py:308-312 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` and `spec.loader` are used in `_collect_report_pr_cases()` without a None check.
  WHY: Rated NIT. If spec creation fails, an AttributeError/TypeError is raised at import time and none of the tests in the file are collected. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion (the Copilot inline comment), not as a finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:lines 1910-1914 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In the "Send Telegram notification" step, `ALERT_LEVEL="DEBUG"` is raised to WARNING for both `pr_auto_merge` and `pr_open`. `pr_auto_merge` is set only after `gh pr merge --auto --squash --match-head-commit` succeeds, so the comment "A report PR that did not land needs a person to merge it." is true only for `pr_open`.
  WHY: Under tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py lines 2-7 and the default threshold in scripts/tg_helpers.sh line 86 (`${ALERT_MSG_LEVEL:-WARNING}`), a run on a protected branch that usually ends at `pr_auto_merge` sends a WARNING page for a PR that merges itself. Fix: raise only `pr_open`. The static test assertion still matches.

Fix: `assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, ...`. About 1 line.
